draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and no statistical tests. There is no T2 table, no noise perturbation experiments, and no 0.6/1.3/1.8 point drop values. The claim's entire numeric and robustness content is unsupported.
